prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: country learning postcard for Belarus
Primary request: Mir Castle Complex with its distinctive red-brick and white-plaster towers beside its landscaped pond.
Subject: Recognizable square-plan castle, strong multi-storey corner towers and gate tower, square lower tower sections and faceted upper sections under terracotta pyramidal roofs; rich red brick contrasted with white plaster recessed panels, arcades and palatial inner wings. Show only towers appropriate to the three-quarter viewpoint.
Scene/backdrop: Green park lawn and leafy trees, a calm pond in the foreground reflecting the castle, a grassy bank between water and castle, blue sky. This is a flat Belarusian park setting, not a mountaintop castle.
Style/medium: Cheerful detailed children's-book travel illustration, painterly gouache and digital watercolour with visible brush texture, believable recognizable landmark geometry, gentle saturated teal, ochre, green and coral.
Composition/framing: One landscape 3:2 image, intended 1536x1024. Wide scenic three-quarter view with the complete castle comfortably inside central 75% width and height, generous sky and pond around it for cropping.
Lighting/mood: Warm natural daylight, calm and inviting.
Constraints: Stylized educational illustration. No text or letters, UI, flags, logos, watermark, postcard frame or stamp. No round fairy-tale turrets, mountains, unrelated landmark or invented geography.
inspection: Inspected: recognizable red-brick and white-plaster Mir Castle, strong corner towers with faceted upper sections and terracotta pyramidal roofs, green park and reflected pond. No readable text, country flags, UI or logos; tiny roof weather-vane silhouettes are present. Tall tower tops extend beyond the central 75% height; contain sizing preserves them.
